allowed_named_refusals: Specified Blocking/unknown worksheet elements or ext URIs; ambiguous/malformed relationship ownership; query-fed table bands; table column/header/all-data band removal; array/data-table/pivot splitting; grid/cell limits and distinct table collisions.

Previously disclosed unsupported opaque VML/image/thread dependency shapes and unresolved callable/name scopes stay separate named limits, not excuses to refuse ordinary listed carried records.

historical_findings.current: Whole moved protectedRange and ignoredError sqref, and cellWatch r, are refused as unported. Destination covered registrations are already removed by the normal planned frame rewrite.
historical_findings.required: Transfer source-selected children and merge surviving destination containers, preserving each child attribute, namespace/MCE scope and frame order. A cellWatch must use ownership-aware range partitioning rather than discarding the sheet returned by Shift::place.

historical_findings.current: Whole selected worksheet autoFilter/sortState is refused. Table-owned filter/sort transfer is already implemented and is a separate owner.
historical_findings.required: Move a complete worksheet filter/sort registration using an ownership-aware singular range result. Retain filterColumn colId offsets and nested sort ranges; account for any worksheet-local _xlnm._FilterDatabase name through the existing Names owner. A distinct surviving destination filter cannot silently be overwritten.
historical_findings.allowed_limits: A single-ref filter or sort extent cannot encode a disconnected remainder. Retain a typed located refusal for a genuinely unrepresentable split or conflicting singular destination registration; blanket whole-object refusal is the missing behavior.

historical_findings.source: carried.rs::SHIFTED_EXTENSIONS; workbook.rs::refuse_untransferred_carried / Registration::standard_transfer_only; shift.rs::GatherX14 / is_x14_host / SheetEdits
historical_findings.current: Recognized extLst entries are classified Shifted and adjusted for bands, but a moved xm:sqref is refused. The current standard_transfer_only gate correctly does not admit these namespaces by accident.
historical_findings.required: Partition recognized ext children by their exact URI and expanded element names using Registration; preserve their envelopes and unrelated children. Transfer x14 CF/DV and sparkline children with the existing formula/range adjuster. Merge singleton extension entries instead of duplicating the URI.
constraints: CF priorities share a worksheet-wide domain across legacy and x14 rules. Priority-less x14 data-bar records link to legacy rules by GUID and must move with the linked rule, not receive invented independent priority.
Sparkline group settings and optional date-axis xm:f travel with moved members; individual sparkline data xm:f is a source reference, not a relative formula hosted at the display cell.
Namespace/MCE semantics use the existing Registration fragment path. Unknown URI, unsupported changed inherited directives, malformed/ambiguous identities remain named refusals.

historical_findings.current: Cross-sheet partly intersected carried ranges refuse before mutation; same-sheet relocate only moves wholly enclosed ranges. Existing tests pin cross-sheet partial CF-source and DV-destination refusal.
historical_findings.required: For representable sqref families, retain old rectangle minus selected/overwritten intersection and transfer the translated intersection. Preserve formula meaning by rehosting each resulting registration through SheetEdits::host_of/formula. Source selection wins an overlapping same-sheet destination.
constraints: Do not change scalar formula-reference relocate semantics to use sqref fragmentation. A carried range partition is a bounded geometry result owned in shift.rs.

A rectangle remainder is at most four disjoint rectangles; sqref can carry their union. Hyperlink ref is singular, so multiple pieces require cloned registrations and shared/remapped relationship ownership, not an invalid whitespace ref.
Keep scalar/ref-only filters and unknown opaque shapes refused when no lossless representation exists. These are different from ordinary CF/DV sqref splits that the format can represent.

remaining.current: Split or same-sheet carried owners with host-dependent relative area formulas retain a located atomic refusal. Disjoint components, fixed absolute areas and supported whole cross-sheet copies follow native-observed policies; no approximate rewrite is published.

Unknown/changed MCE meanings, incompatible selected extension payloads, conflicting singular destination filters and unrepresentable disconnected single-ref shapes retain typed located refusals. These are bounded representability limits, not blanket refusal of the four historical carried families.
